fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Equipment is only useful if it changes your appointment

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Every piece of technology below earns its place by doing one of three things: showing you what we can see, making treatment more accurate, or getting you out of the chair sooner.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A small camera that puts high-resolution images of your own teeth on the screen in front of you. It means you can see what we see, rather than taking our word for it - and the images stay in your record, so we can compare over time.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Used during root canal treatment to measure the exact length of the root canal. More accurate work, and fewer X-rays along the way.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: In-house three-dimensional imaging for implant planning, wisdom teeth and complex cases. Because it’s here, you don’t get sent across town for a scan and back again a week later.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: In-practice whitening, usually completed in about an hour. Your gums and lips are protected, then the gel is activated by light. Suitability is assessed first and results vary from person to person.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Used for crown lengthening, gummy smile recontouring, frenula and soft tissue folds. It typically means no sutures, less bleeding and faster healing, and often no anaesthetic is needed - though that depends on the procedure and on you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A digital scan instead of putty impressions, a 3D design, and your crown milled here on site and fitted the same day. No temporary crown, no second appointment. It isn’t suitable for every case, and we’ll tell you if yours is one of them.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our protocols meet or exceed Australian Dental Association and Australian government standards. Instruments are vacuum-packed and stay sealed until they’re used in front of you, with single-use items and PPE where appropriate, checked daily.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ceiling-mounted screens with Netflix or music. It sounds like a small thing; for anxious patients and long appointments it is not a small thing.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Having imaging, scanning and milling under one roof changes the shape of treatment. A crown becomes one appointment instead of two. An implant plan is made from your own 3D scan the same week you ask about it. And when we tell you a tooth needs work, we can show you why on screen.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: None of it replaces the conversation - it just means the conversation is based on something you can both see.
